name: Inbound funnel — lead to booking
description: Live conversion funnel for the agent-native lead router: form → enrichment → LLM ICP scoring → human gate → round-robin routing → booked meeting.

panels.title: Funnel — submissions to bookings (all time)
panels.sql: SELECT CASE event_name WHEN 'lead_submitted' THEN '1 submitted' WHEN 'lead_enriched' THEN '2 enriched' WHEN 'lead_scored' THEN '3 scored' WHEN 'lead_routed' THEN '4 routed' WHEN 'lead_booked' THEN '5 booked' ELSE event_name END AS stage, COUNT(*) AS n FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name IN ('lead_submitted','lead_enriched','lead_scored','lead_routed','lead_booked') GROUP BY event_name ORDER BY CASE event_name WHEN 'lead_submitted' THEN 1 WHEN 'lead_enriched' THEN 2 WHEN 'lead_scored' THEN 3 WHEN 'lead_routed' THEN 4 WHEN 'lead_booked' THEN 5 ELSE 9 END

config.description: Leads reaching each pipeline stage (agent-enriched, LLM-scored, routed, booked).

panels.title: Submissions by day (all time)
panels.sql: SELECT event_date AS date, COUNT(*) AS submissions FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'lead_submitted' GROUP BY event_date ORDER BY date

panels.title: Fit tier distribution (all time)
panels.sql: SELECT COALESCE(properties::jsonb ->> 'tier', 'unknown') AS tier, COUNT(*) AS n FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'lead_scored' GROUP BY tier ORDER BY n DESC

config.description: ICP fit tiers assigned by the LLM scorer (high auto-routes, medium parks for human review, low is disqualified).

panels.title: Median seconds to route (all time)
panels.sql: WITH t0 AS (SELECT anonymous_id, MIN(timestamp::timestamptz) AS started FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name='lead_submitted' GROUP BY anonymous_id), t1 AS (SELECT anonymous_id, MIN(timestamp::timestamptz) AS routed FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name='lead_routed' GROUP BY anonymous_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS routed_leads, COALESCE(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t1.routed - t0.started))), 0)::int AS median_seconds FROM t0 JOIN t1 USING (anonymous_id)

config.description: Median wall-clock seconds from form submit to AE assignment (includes enrichment + LLM scoring).

panels.title: Median approval latency, seconds (all time)
panels.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT anonymous_id, MIN(timestamp::timestamptz) AS parked FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name='lead_routing_proposed' AND properties::jsonb ->> 'band' = 'review' GROUP BY anonymous_id), d AS (SELECT anonymous_id, MIN(timestamp::timestamptz) AS decided FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name IN ('lead_approved','lead_rejected') GROUP BY anonymous_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS decided, COALESCE(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d.decided - p.parked))), 0)::int AS median_seconds FROM p JOIN d USING (anonymous_id)

config.description: Median seconds mid-band leads wait in the human review queue before an approve/reject decision.

panels.title: Qualifier accuracy — latest golden eval (all time)
panels.sql: SELECT (properties::jsonb ->> 'accuracy')::float AS accuracy, properties::jsonb ->> 'model' AS model, timestamp FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'eval_completed' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

config.description: Latest golden-suite accuracy of the ICP scorer (tier + segment + route decision vs 24 labeled cases).

panels.title: Awaiting human review (all time)
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open FROM (SELECT anonymous_id FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name='lead_routing_proposed' AND properties::jsonb->>'band'='review' GROUP BY anonymous_id) p LEFT JOIN (SELECT anonymous_id FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name IN ('lead_approved','lead_rejected') GROUP BY anonymous_id) d USING (anonymous_id) WHERE d.anonymous_id IS NULL

config.description: Mid-band leads parked in the review queue right now (HITL gate).

panels.title: Segment distribution (all time)
panels.sql: SELECT COALESCE(properties::jsonb ->> 'segment', 'unknown') AS segment, COUNT(*) AS n FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'lead_scored' GROUP BY segment ORDER BY n DESC

config.description: Buyer segments inferred by the scorer — drives which routing rule and AE calendar a lead lands on.

panels.title: Recent scored leads (all time)
panels.sql: SELECT timestamp AS time, properties::jsonb ->> 'tier' AS tier, properties::jsonb ->> 'segment' AS segment, properties::jsonb ->> 'fitScore' AS fit, properties::jsonb ->> 'model' AS model FROM analytics_events WHERE event_name = 'lead_scored' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 15

config.description: Latest scorer outputs (no PII — synthetic demo leads only).
